verdict_text:
YES

The script merges each of the 16 `query_key_value` weights as `W + 2 * B @ A` in float32 (adapter tensors are float32, base is upcast) and casts back to the base float16 dtype, respects `fan_in_fan_out` via the config, leaves no `lora_` or intermediate tensors in the state dict, enforces all four required checks with assertions before writing, and writes the result through `save_sharded_safetensors` with the 536,870,912-byte limit into `out/T5`. The only part not visible here is the `_ckpt` helper that implements the shard packing and index file, so the sharding-rule conformance rests on that helper behaving as its name and limit argument indicate.
